title: RetryFailedPaymentAction
description: An action an internal agent can PROPOSE to retry a failed payment. It does nothing until a human approves it. The executor re-checks the order state before acting.

actionId.description: Unique id. Doubles as the idempotency key when the action is executed, so it can only run once.

amount.description: In paise. Must equal the order total; the executor rejects the action if it doesn't.

reason.description: Why the agent thinks a retry is safe, e.g. the failure code was a transient bank timeout.

evidence.description: What the agent looked at, so the approver doesn't have to dig.

status.description: Only PROPOSED -> APPROVED|REJECTED|EXPIRED and APPROVED -> EXECUTED are allowed.

approval.description: Filled in by a human. Must be null while status is PROPOSED.

approvedBy.description: A human. Must not equal proposedBy.

expiresAt.description: Approval window. An action approved after this time is not executed.
